about_the_game:
"Cali and the Kingdom of the Yard" is an 8-scene puzzle game where we follow the life of the kitten Cali. Follow her story full of discoveries with beautiful images made from Cali's point of view, showing the exploratory, imaginative, and curious side of cats.

 

In the first game, our kitten was adopted, faced a swordswoman, explored a giant desert, among other adventures. The last chapter we witnessed of her story is her encounter with a dog that, although clearly friendly, to Cali seems like a terrifying creature. In this game, follow Cali's new adventures, starting from her reaction to the unexpected encounter.

 

Game Features:

  • 🧩 3 difficulty levels: Easy (144 pieces), Medium (350 pieces), Hard (777 pieces).

  • 🎵 Original soundtrack: Relaxing and immersive.

  • 🔍 Helpful tools: Zoom, highlight pieces (edges/specific quadrants), shuffle pieces and image preview.

  • 📖 Engaging story: Each completed scene reveals a chapter of Cali's journey!

 

This is a game for cat lovers! But we also aim to raise awareness about the importance of adopting black cats, who are often overlooked in shelters due to spiritual prejudices or being seen as too "common". Black cats are just as beautiful and full of love to give as any other cat!

short_description: Cali in new adventures! Our kitten's last adventure was an unexpected encounter with an extremely dangerous creature: a playful golden retriever wanting to make friends! Curious to know how this encounter ends? Follow new scenes from Cali's story in this puzzle game, composed of 8 levels.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Danish, Finnish, Dutch, Japanese, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Swedish, Czech, Turkish, Ukrainian
